I found three Marrow Fieldworks ticket numbers and sent you the list in our DM:

1. #4409, from Moss's digest "Central handoffs next week" (2 Jan 2026). It's a recurring timeout on the Gatehouse Check-In report at the Salina North yard. Hollis flagged it as open before the 5 Jan handoff.
2. #4412, from the same Moss digest. It's a minor driver SMS prompt glitch when staging combine trailers on overflow lots. Hollis flagged this one too.
3. PD-5302, from #central-random. Hollis posted it on 14 Oct as a follow-up ticket from this week.

What I left out:
- FR-882, in the same digest, belongs to Marrow Agrisupply, not Marrow Fieldworks. It's also a feature request, not a support ticket.
- #8841, in #central-random on 13 Oct, is on "Tobias's dealer account." That message doesn't name the account, so I can't tell whether it's Marrow Fieldworks. Tobias would know.
- Moss's other notes (the Central cheat sheet and the North digests) have no Marrow Fieldworks tickets.

For this week's chat, I also checked #central-team, #general, #help-it-ops and #inc-tansley-carrier-api. None of them has any messages this week, so #central-random was the only one with anything. I couldn't see any Marrow Fieldworks ticket files in the shared drive either.
